title: Release envelope and cross-implementation claim audit
scope: Confirm the current AutoCAD product-release to DWG file-version mapping.
Separate peer format/version matrices from direction-specific entity, object, graph, writer, and consumer evidence.
Reconcile current LibreDWG, ACadSharp, and ezdxf public evidence with existing local plan owners without promoting peer issue reports into local defects.
Refine the existing fast implementation and composed-comparison procedure without adding dependencies, fixtures, or support claims.

sources.revision: Official compatibility article dated 2026-05-27 and DWG version-code page accessed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The current compatibility table lists AutoCAD 2018 through AutoCAD 2027 as using the AutoCAD 2018 native drawing format. Autodesk's code table maps AutoCAD 2018/2019/2020/2021/2022/2023/2024 to AC1032; the current product table extends the same release family through 2027.
sources.limits: This maps product releases to the container/file-version code only. It does not establish identical object semantics across producers or support for any named entity/object profile.

sources.revision: Mutable master README/manual/NEWS and test-tree overview reviewed 2026-10-20; no commit or executable was pinned.
sources.observed: README names direction-specific tool coverage and says dwgrewrite re-reads output for confirmation; NEWS labels the 0.14.1 (2026-07-25) entry beta and announces newly added AC1018/R2004 DWG writing; the manual makes broad version coverage statements; README points to test/xmlsuite feature comparisons.
sources.limits: Project documentation and self-tests do not provide a normalized per-feature external success rate. Same-project readback is a consistency test, not independent consumer acceptance. Mutable source was not built or run.

sources.revision: Mutable version matrix and issue statuses reviewed 2026-10-20. The issue page describes ACadSharp 3.6.35 for #1172, 3.4.9 for #1195, and 3.8.0/master-era source for several newer reports.
sources.observed: The public version matrix advertises DWG/DXF routes through AC1032. Open issue reports describe AC1032 INSERT loss, DXF 3DSOLID/REGION omission, a VERTEX subtype edge, repeated-record stack growth, an EED size-narrowing case, and whole-file AC1032 MTEXT rejection.
sources.limits: Issues are peer-reported at different versions and with different reproduction quality/root-cause confidence. The findings are already mapped to local parser, graph, carrier, writer, and acceptance owners; none is by itself a libdxfrw defect or a normative DWG/DXF rule. No peer sample was downloaded and no runtime was used.

sources.revision: Mutable README and XREF documentation reviewed 2026-10-20.
sources.observed: The README documents ASCII/Binary DXF version support, while XREF documentation explicitly narrows its import module to copyable/transformable basic entities and excludes ACAD_TABLE and preserved unknown/proxy records.
sources.limits: Documentation defines route scope, not a runtime comparison. ezdxf was not installed or executed.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-07/S8: normalize external evidence by exact artifact, operation direction, file version, entity/object profile, source identity, graph closure, and consumer; distinguish self-readback from independent validation.
PAR-06/PAR-49: use explicit per-source identity disposition across decode, callback/model, writer, and reopened output; counts and successful exits are not sufficient.
Version matrix: AC1032 remains the current AutoCAD format through 2027; record product release separately and do not invent a new container parser branch.
PAR-14/PAR-19/PAR-20/PAR-126 and existing ACIS gates: route peer issue reports to existing local owners before considering new findings or tests.

planChanges: Added Autodesk's current AutoCAD 2018-2027 to AC1032 release mapping and clarified that product release and record semantics remain separate evidence axes.
Compared LibreDWG README/NEWS/manual/test-method descriptions and refined optional peer admission to require exact operation direction, profile, artifact, and evidence class.
Reconciled ACadSharp's public AC1032 support matrix and current issue reports with existing local owners; no duplicate tests, findings, or code changes were justified.
Added an implementation-ready per-source disposition and bounded external-check procedure while preserving fast local validation, fixture policy, self-unblocking, and external deferred states.
limitations: Mutable project documentation was not pinned to immutable source commits unless the source itself names a release.
Peer issue descriptions are reports, not verified local behavior or normative format specifications.
No external DWG/DXF sample was downloaded or committed; no peer or native-CAD program was run.
No new issue was promoted; J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
